subject: large chest
text: A large chest reached past the rolling boulder contains the Kokiri Sword.

evidence.quote: Start running east and then make a right...This will lead you to a large chest which contains the...KOKIRI SWORD.

subject: four treasure chests
object: Blue Rupee, Recovery Heart, Green Rupee
text: Four treasure chests inside the house beside the circle of rocks contain a Blue Rupee, a Recovery Heart, a Blue Rupee, and a Green Rupee.

evidence.quote: There are four treasure chests in this room...open them all to acquire a BLUE RUPEE, a RECOVERY HEART, a BLUE RUPEE...pathetic GREEN RUPEE.

subject: water platforms
text: Jumping across all three square platforms on the water awards a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: Jump across all three of these platforms...water to get a Blue Rupee.

subject: raised platform
text: Crossing two bridges from the building east of Link's house leads to a raised platform with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote: leads to a bridge, cross this bridge and the other bridge...raised platform with a girl and a Blue Rupee on it.

subject: blue Rupees
text: Blue Rupees are worth five Rupees apiece.

evidence.quote: these are worth five Rupees apiece.

subject: shield
text: Purchasing the shield requires accumulating 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote: accumulate the 40 Rupees that you will need.
